en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestone street leading uphill to a medieval city gate tower with a tall, simple hipped roof and small windows. The arched gateway forms a tunnel through the tower, with a glimpse of trees and houses beyond. On the right side of the street is a row of plastered houses with shop signs and a doorway; on the left are simpler residential buildings. A few people, including children, stand near the archway. The architecture suggests a small Central European town with preserved fortifications.
